# dsh-mcp-tavily

**Tavily web search for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)** — a
plugin bundle with two halves: it serves the

built-in `web_search` from Tavily's API, and bridges Tavily's
hosted **remote MCP server** for `craw

l` / `map` / `research`. The API key is set on a small card in the
Plugins panel. No local server, n
o `npx`, no build step.

**给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Tavily 联网搜索** —— 两半：让内置 `web_search` 改由 Tavily 供货，并桥接
Tavily 的**远程 MCP 服务器**（

爬站 / 站点地图 / 深度研究）。API Key 在插件面板的小卡片里填。
不需要本地起服务、不需要 `npx`、不需要构建。
## Why / 为什么
DSH's built-in `web_search` is backed by DeepSeek's own endpoint: every search is a full auxiliary m

odel
turn billed as tokens on your DeepSeek account. This bundle points that seam at Tavily instead,

and adds
Tavily's MCP tools on top, so ordinary lookups spend Tavily's free monthly credits (1,000/

month) and the
heavier work — `crawl` / `map` / `research` — becomes available at all.

DSH 内置的 `web_search` 走 DeepSeek 自己的端点，每次搜索都是"一次完整的辅助模型请求"，按 token 计费。
本插件把这条 seam 指向 Tavily，并额外接上 Ta

vily 的 MCP 工具：日常检索花 Tavily 的免费额度
（1,000 credits/月），重活（爬站 / 站点地图 / 深度研究）也才有得用。
## Tools added / 新增工具
| Tool | What it does / 作用 |

| `web_search` | The built-in tool, unchanged for the model — now answered by Tavily. |
| `mcp__tavi
ly__tavily_search` | Web search — supports `include_domains`, `exclude_domains`, `time_range`, `sear

ch_depth: advanced` |
| `mcp__tavily__tavily_extract` | Extract the readable content of given URLs (

markdown / text) |
| `mcp__tavily__tavily_map` | List a site's URL structure |
| `mcp__tavily__tavil

y_crawl` | Crawl a whole site and extract content |
| `mcp__tavily__tavily_research` | Multi-source

a whole site and extract content |
| `mcp__tavily__tavily_research` | Multi-source research report |
Plus MCP resource reading (`list_mcp_resources` / `read_mcp_resource`) when the server exposes resou
MCP resource reading (`list_mcp_resources` / `read_mcp_resource`) when the server exposes resources.
## Install / 安装
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh` once — bundles and their patches are resolved at boot.
重启一次 `dsh`（bundle 和补丁是启动时解析的）。
## Visual configuration / 可视化配置
The key is typed into the UI; no environment variable is required.
**Plugins -> `dsh-mcp-tavily`** — the card sits on the bundle page between its description and its r

ows.
The same form is also reachable from the row's **Configure** control.
| Control | Meaning |
| **API Key** | A Tavily key (`tvly-...`), written to the credentials plane (`TAVILY_API_KEY`) as a

secret — never to a settings file, never into this repository. |
| **Show / Hide** | Reveal the draf

t before saving. |
| **Save / Clear key** | Store or remove the credential. |
The status line is read from the credentials store, so it says exactly which source is in play:
| Status | Meaning |
| `Tavily API key configured` | Stored on the credentials plane — the card owns it and can replace o

r clear it. |
| `Supplied by the launch environment's TAVILY_API_KEY (read-only here)` | The key com
es from the environment of the process that started `dsh`. The store refuses to shadow it, so **Save

is disabled**: delete that environment variable first if you want the card to own the key. |
| `No
key on the credentials plane ...` | Neither source has a key; searches use Tavily's free rate-limite
tials plane ...` | Neither source has a key; searches use Tavily's free rate-limited keyless mode. |
**When a change takes effect**: the built-in `web_search` re-resolves the key on every request, so a

key
saved in the card applies immediately. The MCP tools fix their `Authorization` header when thei

r client is
mounted, so a **newly saved key reaches them on the next restart**.

**生效时机**：内置 `web_search` 每次请求都重新解析 key，所以卡片里保存后**立即生效**；MCP 工具在挂载时
固定请求头，**新 key 需要下次重启**才对它们生效。
## Key resolution order / Key 解析顺序

1. An explicit `apiKey` in the plugin's config, if a settings surface supplies one;
2. the credentia

ls plane, under the `apiKeyEnv` reference (default `TAVILY_API_KEY`);
3. the process environment, sa

me reference;
4. otherwise Tavily's free, rate-limited **keyless** mode.
Both halves use the same function, which is why the card can key the MCP tools too.
## Configure without the card / 不用卡片
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Get a free key at <https://app.tavily.com> (1,000 credits/month, no credit card). With nothing confi

gured
at all, both halves still work through Tavily's keyless mode — which supports `search` and `ex

tract` only
(no `crawl` / `map` / `research`), at a lower rate limit.
## Compatibility / 兼容性

- Verified against **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2** on Windows (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 0.2.0-rc.2).
- The h

ost half depends on the MCP client's `serverName` / `transport` / `url` / `headers` config fields
an

d on the `ctx.web` search-provider seam.
- The card needs a dsh whose client supports the `plugins.b

undle.config` slot and a package-level
`dsh.client` manifest. On an older build the host halves stil

l work; only the card is missing.
- `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` is optional: without it the provider

still runs and simply exposes no
schema-derived settings form.
## Security / 安全

- **No secrets in this repository, and none in the patch.** The key lives on the credentials plane
(

`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, or the store your dsh mounts) or in your environment.
- The key is ne

ver put into the URL, where it would leak into logs and proxies.
- Outbound traffic is one HTTPS con

nection to `https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/` plus the `api.tavily.com`
search endpoint; your queries and

this plugin's user agent are the only things sent there (Tavily's own
terms apply).
- No install-ti
me scripts; nothing is compiled at install time.
